foodStyleStudy.prompt:
Food style study for a Filipino bakery game. Image 1 supplies food identities only; image 2 is the PRIMARY STYLE TARGET, the simple handmade miniature bakery diorama. Create a THREE-CELL HORIZONTAL SPRITE STRIP, one equal square cell per food, transparent outside, no labels or text. Left: PANDESAL, two small intentionally sculpted oval bread rolls, one slightly tilted, one broad shallow crease each. Middle: ENSAYMADA, a low broad brioche with ONE broad loose curved fold and EXACTLY THREE short, thick, deliberately placed ivory cheese batons, not a tangle. Right: UBE CHEESE PANDESAL, one simple cut-open plump bun with muted purple dough, ONE broad dark-purple rounded filling shape and ONE small ivory cheese wedge. All three rest on identical plain shallow warm-cream plates, same scale and front three-quarter viewing angle, soft contact shadow.
CRITICAL SIMPLICITY: Rebuild the objects with a tiny number of clean sculpted forms, like wooden toy foods in a miniature diorama. NO grains, pores, speckles, crumbs, sesame, dots, sprinkles, wrinkles, numerous ridges, complex swirls, strands, photoreal texture, material noise or decorative toppings. Do not blur the old artwork: actually REMOVE tiny geometry and surface information. Each food has just 2–3 broad hand-chosen color/shading regions: softly lit top, warm front plane, slightly darker underside. ONE subtle transition may communicate curvature, but no complex baking gradient, SSS translucency or specular shine. The shape has convincing thickness and a little asymmetry, not a flat vector sticker and not generic inflated spheres. Matte surfaces, muted golden-cream pandesal, soft butter-yellow ensaymada, restrained mauve/dark purple ube. Gentle upper-right light and mild contact occlusion only. The plate is a simple solid cream dish with one shaded rim, no rings or tiny detail. Place each sprite in central 80% of its square cell with its plate baseline at 86%. Equal transparent padding, no objects crossing cells. Three miniature game collectibles in the visual world of image 2, drawn with very low visual complexity. Wide 3:1 canvas.
